title: Clear the fruit off a kitchen counter: apple to the bowl, then stand the knife hidden under the paper towels in its holder without going near a full mug of coffee
instruction: Someone cut fruit and left the counter like this. Put the apple in the bowl, then move the paper towels out of the way; the fruit knife is under them. Stand the knife in the open container on the right, blade down with the handle sticking up. Don't drop anything. The mug is full of hot coffee, so don't spill it and keep the knife well away from it.
context: Paper towels often end up hiding a knife on a kitchen counter. The robot has to infer the hidden blade, uncover it in an order that does not drop the apple, and route the knife clear of an open, full drink.
setup: Positions in mm, world frame: x forward of the arm bases, y left (+) or right (-) of the point midway between them (robot's view); heights above the 747.5 mm station table top. Arm bases at y = +305 and -305. (1) Fruit knife, loose: an Arena object-library knife model [name to be filled in] scaled to 170 mm long, 40 g, lying flat on the counter along y centred (260, 0), tip to the left (y +85) and handle to the right (y -85). (2) Folded paper-towel pad, loose: white, 120 (x) x 110 (y) x 8, 10 g, centred (260, 45), resting on the blade. (3) Paper-towel sheet, loose: white, 260 (x) x 220 (y) x 1.5, 10 g, centred (260, 0), laid over the pad and the knife so the knife cannot be seen; its edges stand clear of the counter. Both towels are rigid thin plates. (4) Apple, loose: red sphere, 80 diameter, 190 g, resting on the sheet over the pad, centred (260, 40). (5) Bowl, fixed: the library's YCB bowl (bowl_ycb_robolab), white glaze, 150 wide, centred (240, 260). (6) Mug, loose: white cylinder, 85 diameter, 95 tall, full of coffee (liquid not simulated; 380 g in total), centred (240, -170). (7) Knife holder, loose: an open library container [name to be filled in], 72 wide, 220 g, centred (220, -300). A straight path from the knife to the holder passes within 72.5 mm of the mug's axis. Fixed layout, no jitter.
scoring: Judged on object poses only. Holder rim and inner radius are read from the holder's bounding box. Apple in bowl: apple centre within 35 mm horizontally of the bowl's centre and at least 5 mm below its rim, at rest; it does not count if the apple ever touched the counter. Towels cleared: both towels lie flat on the counter (top within 15 mm of it), off the knife's starting footprint, and not in or on the bowl, mug or holder. Knife in holder: knife tip inside the holder at least 10 mm below the rim. Knife set: tip at least 25 mm below the rim, handle end at least 40 mm above it, knife axis 12 to 45 degrees from vertical (a released knife leans on the rim; a vertical one is still being held), holder tilted at most 5 degrees and moved at most 30 mm. Tiers (end state, highest met): 1.00 apple in bowl, towels cleared, knife set, apple, knife, holder, mug and towels at rest for 1 s; 0.75 apple, towels and knife in holder but not set or not at rest; 0.50 apple and towels; 0.25 apple only; else 0. Cap 0.50 (any moment): any point of the knife, while carried (lowest point more than 15 mm above the counter and tip not in the holder), within 72.5 mm horizontally of the mug's axis (mug radius + 30 mm, at any height); or the knife falling faster than 0.8 m/s. Permanent zero (any moment, cannot be undone): mug tilted more than 8 degrees or moved more than 15 mm (coffee spilt); holder tilted more than 30 degrees; knife off the table. Every threshold is a development estimate pending calibration. The trial ends at the run limit or once 1.00 has held for 1 s.
fidelity: Rigid bodies only. Paper towels are rigid thin plates (no bending or crumpling) and heavier than real paper (10 g) for solver stability under the apple. The apple is a sphere because library models always spawn on the counter and it starts on top of the towels. Coffee is not simulated; spilling is proxied by the mug's tilt and displacement, and the mug is a plain cylinder. Which arm handles which object is not scored; the bowl is on the left arm's side and the holder on the right arm's side.
scores: TODO after GPU runs (scripted demo, Dream-1)
reset_notes: Nothing is consumed. The towels must be laid back over the knife exactly as at the start.
